blocks.x: All it takes is a few minutes on Condé Nast Traveler’s website to realize how big of a fan we are of Expedia. The only thing better than planning a memorable trip to dreamy destinations like the Caribbean, Tokyo, or California is scoring a great deal on said trip. Booking through Expedia offers travelers a hassle-free way to book everything they need for an upcoming vacation on a single platform. From flights and rental cars to hotels, cruises, and packages, you can browse through the top picks around the world, featuring ratings and reviews by real travelers just like you.

With top properties from every corner of the world, Expedia makes it easy to compare and contrast amenities, prices, and ratings all on the same platform. I particularly like the breadth of options available and the ease of navigating the site, which is why I always find myself turning to Expedia when considering where to stay on my next trip. No matter where I’m headed or what type of stay I’m looking for, Expedia has an option for every type of trip (and every type of traveler). Whether you’re on the hunt for a sunny beach escape or prefer to bed down in the heart of a big city, book with Expedia to save on your travel needs. Below, read on for the best Expedia coupons and promo codes for travelers to use all year round.
Save 25% or more on your dream vacation with top Expedia coupons

Scheduling your next big trip? Expedia makes it easy—and budget-friendly—to pick out the perfect place to stay for every type of traveler. Whether you’re looking for iconic beach views, a city getaway, a property ensconced in the solitude of nature, or something else entirely, you’ll be able to score over 25% off on tons of properties across the world, from Montreal to Mexico City, by taking a peek at the site's Top Deals page. For example, you can currently score 41% off the One Hotel Brooklyn Bridge (a personal favorite of mine in Brooklyn), 40% off the Shinjuku Granbell Hotel in Tokyo, 38% off the Hotel Riu Plaza Toronto, and 27% off the Ocean Z Boutique Hotel in Aruba. Get ready to check some major spots off your bucket list!

For especially steep discounts, use Expedia's last-minute hotel deals to score the best rates on spontaneous travel. To spot these deals, look for the green reduced price tag above the original rate when scrolling through the website. The discounts in green will highlight exactly how much you can expect to save when booking a property for a stay within the next 14 days. Members can expect even more savings when they check out the member-specific last-minute deals, which feature chic hotels around the world, including Public in NYC, and Virgin Hotels Las Vegas, a four-time RCA winner.
Unlock up to 30% off with Expedia promo codes and member discounts

Whether you’re headed somewhere warm like Miami or planning a cozy fall getaway to upstate New York, there are plenty of ways to save right now with Expedia promo codes and discounts. Members can also score up to $1,275 off packages to top destinations like Cancún and Honolulu, save on flight deals, and get more than 15% off select activities. Select packages to hot destinations like Miami Beach and Jamaica are even offering 100% off flights, so there’s never been a better time to book that upcoming winter sun vacay. Plus, you’ll get the opportunity to get $350 in OneKeyCash.

I’m personally eyeing the package to Casa de Campo in Punta Cana, which includes flights and a hotel stay with over a 50% discount. The property is also fully refundable in case something pops up and you’re unable to go.

In order to reap the benefits above, you’ll have to sign up to be a One Key member; it’s free to sign up and gives you access to savings and VIP rewards across three brands: Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. Members get up to 10% off regular prices when they’re logged in to their accounts, plus have opportunities for exclusive promo codes, freebies, and travel credits. Even better, you can save up to 20% on select hotels when you book through the Expedia app, and you’ll be registered automatically as a member when you sign in.

Apply for a OneKey+ credit card and earn up to $400 in OneKeyCash after spending $3,000 in the first three months (and an extra $100 OneKeyCash every year that your card remains open as an anniversary bonus). You’ll also earn 2% in OneKeyCash for every $1 spent on non-flight bookings and 0.2% in OneKeyCash for every $1 spent on flight bookings.
Snag a few free upgrades on your next booking
https://media.cntraveler.com/photos/655645f48a43a61dbf5152d4/1:1/w_90%2Cc_limit/IMG_7445.jpg

You can score freebies for your next getaway by using Expedia's Free Extras platform—just fill out your flight, hotel, bundle, car, cruise, activity, or rental information to see what's on offer. Expedia Free Extras can include everything from free Wi-Fi and breakfast to resort credits, show tickets, room upgrades, and more. We love a bonus!
Students, teachers, military, and seniors get a 10% off Expedia coupon

Expedia occasionally offers student discounts and teacher discounts to those who apply, so it’s worth checking back frequently to see if any new deals pop up. Expedia’s military discounts include 10% off lodging for US military service members. There are also occasional offers specifically for military service members on their site. Senior discounts include a $50 gift card with the purchase of a flight package, up to 10% off select hotels, and up to 30% off select car rentals.
Browse Expedia deals on popular travel destinations

Some of the top travel destinations to look out for are Las Vegas; New York; Los Angeles; Orlando, Florida; and Nashville, Tennessee. Whether you’re booking a beach vacation for a fly-and-flop trip or want to explore the streets of a big city, there are tons of ways to save in all of your favorite cities. Keep an eye on some of the best deals available right now, including 51% off Treasure Island Las Vegas and 37% off Hotel Riu Plaza Chicago.
How do I get cheaper deals on Expedia?

There are endless deals to score right now, thanks to Expedia’s many coupon codes. While Expedia doesn’t have tons of huge sale events, they do frequently offer deals during different holidays, so you can expect to save even more when booking around those times. Plus, there are a variety of discounts to take advantage of, whether you’re a student or a senior. One other thing to keep in mind is Expedia’s great package options, which let you bundle things like flights and hotels for the ultimate savings.

Book during the low season to score flights and hotels that tend to be cheaper than peak periods (off-season usually hits during fall and winter after the holidays). If your schedule is open, you can use flexible travel dates to find the cheapest option. This is best for those who can rearrange their travel with ease and who have no issue flying out mid-week. Gold and Platinum One Key members also get free One Key Price Drop Protection on select flights in the app, so if the flights you book drop in price, you’ll receive the difference in OneKeyCash.
How to fix an Expedia promo code that’s not working

Expedia promo code not working? Here’s what you can do to problem-solve at home. The first step is to make sure you’re typing in the correct code details. Keep an eye on numbers that look like letters (like an uppercase letter O and the number zero), accidental spaces, and incorrect capitalization. If everything looks correct, your next step is to check the fine print. Make sure your promo code hasn’t passed its expiration date, requires certain parameters that you haven't met, or features blackout dates. A few issues that regularly pop up include selecting “Pay Later” at checkout (coupons require you to pay upon booking), trying to book a hotel brand that is excluded from the coupon, or not reaching the minimum spend amount. Finally, to rule out your own hardware or software issues, restart your browser, clear your cookies and cache, or switch devices to try again. If all else fails, reach out to Expedia’s help desk to get more personalized advice.
